title: Notre Dame Fighting Irish at Navy Midshipmen odds, picks and predictions | National | lufkindailynews.com
text:
The No. 6 Notre Dame Fighting Irish (6-1) and the Navy Midshipmen (2-5) meet Saturday at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts. Kickoff is scheduled for noon ET (ABC). Let's analyze college football odds around the Notre Dame vs. Navy odds and make our expert college football picks and predictions for the best bets.
Notre Dame suffered its first loss of the season Oct. 17, falling 28-24 at the No. 9 BYU Cougars in Provo, Utah. QB CJ Carr threw for 261 yards, while RB Nolan James Jr. added 77 rushing yards and a TD. The Fighting Irish failed to cover as 10.5-point favorites while the Over (46.5) cashed.
Navy dropped its second straight game, losing 49-39 Saturday to the North Texas Mean Green despite a monster performance from QB Jackson Gutierrez. He practically carried the Midshipmen on his back, rushing for 228 yards and 3 TDs while throwing for 133 yards and another score. Unfortunately, Navy's defense couldn't slow down the Mean Green. The Midshipmen failed to cover as 2.5-point home underdogs while the Over (60.5) cashed.
Notre Dame has dominated its longtime rivalry with Navy, leading 82-13-1 in the all-time series that started in 1927. The Irish cruised to a 49-10 victory last season, covering as 30.5-point home favorites while the Over (54.5) cashed.
– Rankings: US LBM Coaches Poll, conducted by the American Football Coaches Association and USA TODAY Sports

Notre Dame at Navy odds
Provided by BetMGM Sportsbook; access USA TODAY Sports Scores and Sports Betting Odds hub for a full list. Lines last updated Friday at 12:31 a.m. ET.
- Moneyline (ML): Notre Dame -12500 (bet $12500 to win $100) | Navy +3500 (bet $100 to win $3500)
- Against the spread (ATS): Notre Dame -30 (-118) | Navy +30 (-112)
- Over/Under (O/U): 56.5 (O: -110 | U: -108)
Notre Dame at Navy picks and predictions
Prediction
Notre Dame 45, Navy 10
Moneyline
PASS.
The Fighting Irish (-12500) don't have any value on moneyline, which is why you should look to bet the spread.
Against the spread
BET NOTRE DAME -30 (-118).
Notre Dame enters Saturday's matchup against Navy rested and looking to rebound from its first loss of the season. The Fighting Irish rank third nationally in rushing defense, allowing just 67.3 yards per game, a tough matchup for Navy's run-heavy offense (307.7 yards per game).
The Midshipmen have struggled defensively, allowing 87 points over their last 2 games. Notre Dame averages 41.1 points per contest, while Carr has thrown 16 TDs against just 1 INT. Navy also ranks 123rd nationally in passing defense, surrendering 255.9 yards per game. Notre Dame's offense should have plenty of opportunities to exploit that weakness.
The Fighting Irish have won 5 straight meetings against Navy, outscoring the Midshipmen 142-27 over their last 3 matchups. With an extra week to prepare, Notre Dame should come out firing.
Over/Under
BET UNDER 56.5 (-108).
Notre Dame's defense should make life difficult for Navy's run-heavy offense. The Fighting Irish allow just 13.4 points per game and rank fourth nationally in defensive rushing success rate. Navy averages 307 rushing yards, but just 119.4 passing yards per contest. With the Midshipmen relying on clock-consuming drives and Notre Dame potentially building an early lead, scoring opportunities could be limited.
